feed: ExtensionDetox — VS Code extensions judged malicious
layout: reports/<first character of extension id>/<Publisher_name_version>.json — sharded because GitHub's Contents API lists at most 1000 entries per directory and truncates silently. Every report is listed below regardless.
inclusion_rule: extension is FLAGGED, its latest scan verdict is one of ['HIGH-RISK', 'SUSPICIOUS'], and its composite score is >= 0.6. All three are required: a critical static finding alone yields SUSPICIOUS at any score, including under 0.3, and those are excluded here.

basis_meanings.composite_score: this pipeline scored it >= 0.7 on its own evidence
basis_meanings.marketplace_removal: Microsoft removed it; the judgement is theirs, not ours
basis_meanings.critical_static_finding: static analysis found a CRITICAL issue; this alone flags an extension regardless of its composite score
basis_meanings.unattributed: flagged by a route this exporter does not recognise — treat as a bug

caveat: An entry whose only basis is marketplace_removal is NOT a detection we made. Check analysis_coverage before treating a finding as complete. extracted_references are strings found in the package, not confirmed attacker infrastructure — do not auto-blocklist them.
